note:
Lorencia's quest giver, and OURS rather than 0.75's: Marlon is not in Version075's Lorencia at all. MuMain has him - he is the one NPC its interface flags for the quest dialogue (ZzzInterface.cpp, `bCheckNPC = (monsterIndex == MONSTER_MARLON)`) - and OpenMU's Season Six gives him the 220 quests. The quest he gives here is our own.

He is built the Berdysh Guard's way because MuMain builds him that way: CreateCharacter with MODEL_PLAYER, the five Plate pieces, a Berdysh in Weapon[0]. What sets him apart is the plus - the guards' plate is plain, his is +7 and his polearm +8, so he carries the first chrome tier (TIER_CHROME_1) the guards beside him do not.
parts_from: ZzzCharacter.cpp, case MONSTER_MARLON: BODYPART_HELM/ARMOR/PANTS/GLOVES/BOOTS all MODEL_PLATE_*, each at Level 7, then SetCharacterScale.
right_hand_from: The same case, c->Weapon[0].Type = MODEL_BERDYSH at Level 8, and Weapon[1] empty.
plus_from: The Levels in that case. +7 and +8 both land on RenderPartObjectBodyColor's first refined tier, TIER_CHROME_1 (ZzzObject.cpp:10365): the body at 0.8 and one bright chrome pass over it.
idle_from: SetPlayerStop, as for the Berdysh Guard: he stands on 136,88, outside the safe zone (attributes.png reads 0 there), holding a two-handed spear-group weapon that is neither the Spear nor the Dragon Lance, so PLAYER_STOP_SCYTHE, action 7.
wandering_note: OpenMU spawns him Wandering: one of four spots at a time - Lorencia 136,88, Devias, Noria, Atlans - moved every 60 to 180 minutes (WanderingMerchantsPlugIn). He never walks. Lorencia is the scope, so here he simply stays.
